Doom for me as well. I still can't believe what an amazing transplant from 1993 it managed to be. They didn't make another Doom as if it were still the 90's. They didn't take what's popular with FPS now and make a Doom in that style. They made a Doom as if Doom were made for the first time in 2016. I have never seen a sequel this good, with a gap between games this big, and with a totally different team working on it.
